title: Trying to find a bar and its driving me nuts!
content: My mallworld is based around an area I grew up in, funnily enough I ended moving back there a few years ago which caused it to grow massively. A few months ago a concept "micro-bar" that can only hold 2 customers for a max of 20 minutes opened up around the corner, across the road from the park. It was easy to find at first but it was always full, id get distracted and wonder off. But lately i can't find it at all, last few nights ive been on a mission to find it but there's no trace of it, not even a shuttered shop. Its been making me unreasonably frustrated, I've had this happen with other places/businesses but i always find them, they disappear forever and i forget they even existed. How do i find this bar so i can get it out of my system?
